title: Siege of Crema (1514)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Crema (1514)", at revision 1370740461, opens: "The siege of Crema in 1514 was a significant military engagement set within the broader context of political and martial upheaval in early 16th-century Italy, particularly during the War of the League of Cambrai." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q110448326, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1513–1514 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
